title: Service inside the dev server
author: claude
summary: While the dev server runs, the page can save entries and images through a small service.
what: While `npm run dev` runs, the page can save entries and images through a small service. It does not exist in the release build.
why: The page needs somewhere to save to, but the release build should contain no dev log data.
how:
- The service can list, save and delete entries, and upload and serve images. It blocks path tricks and never overwrites an uploaded image.
- `devlog.html` is not part of the build, so `vite build` produces only the app.
wrong:
- `@types/node` is not installed and no dependencies could be added, so the code check could not understand Node's file tools in the plugin.
- Vite's request type is an empty stub without Node types, so the first version did not pass the code check.
- `npx vite build` run from Git Bash (with the lower-case drive letter `m:`) fails with an `html-proxy` error on `index.html`. It happens before any dev log code is involved.
fix:
- The file work lives in plain `.mjs` files (with a `.d.mts` for types), and the `.ts` plugin only routes requests, using small local types.
- The build was verified from a PowerShell session at `M:\projects\BeMade\render-lab`.

tech.name: Vite
tech.plain: Runs the lab in the browser while we work and builds it for release.

tech.name: TypeScript
tech.plain: A stricter form of JavaScript that catches mistakes before the code runs.

tech.name: Node.js
tech.plain: Runs small command-line programs, such as the dev log tool.
